Stake program entrypoints and helpers for epoch, config, state, and stake history handling.

# Purpose
This header declares the public interface for the stake program used by the runtime. It defines the stake account state size, includes the execution context types, and exposes functions for stake instruction execution, stake configuration initialization, stake state decoding, and stake activation or deactivation calculations. The [`fd_new_warmup_cooldown_rate_epoch`](<#fd_new_warmup_cooldown_rate_epoch>) function computes the epoch that applies warmup or cooldown rate rules, and [`fd_stake_program_execute`](<#fd_stake_program_execute>) is the main entry point for processing stake instructions. The file also documents the native program address `Stake11111111111111111111111111111111111111` and uses include guards to prevent multiple inclusion.
